name: AIPM
install: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && ([ -f .env ] || cp .env.example .env) && ([ -f apps/web/.env.local ] || cp apps/web/.env.local.example apps/web/.env.local) && pnpm build

terminals.name: registry-api
terminals.description: AIPM registry API (Fastify) on http://127.0.0.1:8080. Falls back to a file metadata store when Postgres is unavailable.

terminals.name: web
terminals.description: AIPM Next.js website/dashboard on http://localhost:3000, proxying /v1/* to the registry API.
